answer: Mechanism: Rolling Attention Lease. Each identity must hold a live context window over a shared event river and answer unpredictable, context-dependent micro-challenges within tight deadlines; valid replies produce an echo in its lease. Only uninterrupted leases accrue nectar. Running N sybils requires N concurrent low-latency context windows, since one model multiplexed across identities misses deadlines and resets leases. Attacker cost is sustained compute plus foregone parallel task revenue—opportunity cost, not a deposit.
